quantities.scope: Actual explicit bent/lapped/hooked paths. All starter steel below the posts is charged in full with no displaced-grid-concrete credit. Source plain24/steel78.5 are authored comparison densities; absent wire, chairs, existing grid cage and delivered-density bounds remain explicit.

independentPairs.scope: All explicit independent steel paths, complete135degree tails and closure-plane jogs. Conservative independent box-position norms; a failed lower bound is unresolved geometry, never a physical pass.

internalClosures.scope: Additional nonlocal closure checks within each single bar. Local connected tangent segments are not separate bars; each ordinary arc is less than a full circle. Fabrication/closure strength remains unsupported.

cover.scope: Exact orthogonal source-solid union boundary; segment/expanded-face distances include independent coordinate-box installation/fabrication and interpolation allowances. No cap, beam depth or material is invented; existing grid reinforcement is unknown.
